Look, it’s not like I wanted to believe there was a God watching over me.
Honestly, I just wanted to do whatever I felt like — smoke weed, hook up, and lose myself in video games.

But that doesn’t change the reality that there is a God — all-powerful, all-knowing — who sees everything I do in secret, knows every thought I’ve ever had, and will judge me by His perfect law.
And I’ve broken it. Badly.
I’ve lied, stolen, blasphemed, coveted, done all kinds of wickedness in His eyes.
Because of that, I deserve His judgment: hell.

You might be thinking, “How is that fair? If God is just, how can eternal punishment make sense? And how do you even know He’s real?”
Those are good questions.
Be skeptical. Keep asking.
That’s what I did — and it’s exactly why I make these videos.

My hope is that through the conversations and stories here, you’ll find real answers — not easy ones, but true ones.

Seek, and you will find.

Love,
Jaiden

Media is my medicine.

Living with cystic fibrosis means my days don’t always feel easy.
But movies, TV, and games?
They give me space to breathe. Emotionally, and mentally. 

I don’t just watch to be entertained. I watch to feel.
To escape. To make sense of things.
To connect to stories that say what I can’t always put into words.

On this channel, I break down the shows and films that stay with you long after they end.
Not just the plot, but the feelings, themes, characters, and messages underneath it all.

🧠 If you love breaking down what’s really being shown. 💬 If you watch to feel less alone and more connected. 
😌 If media gives you relief

Then you’re in the right place.

I’m Bobby Foster.
